arguments.command: git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all && echo --- && ls -la && echo --- && cat AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null || echo "no AGENTS.md"

echo "=== CHANGELOG.md ===" && cat CHANGELOG.md
echo "=== git diff wordcount.py ===" && git diff wordcount.py
echo "=== git diff --numstat ===" && git diff --numstat
echo "=== numstat cached (new file CHANGELOG.md) ===" && git diff --cached --numstat -- CHANGELOG.md
echo "=== wc -l tests/test_wordcount.py ===" && wc -l tests/test_wordcount.py
echo "=== tests/test_wordcount.py content ===" && cat tests/test_wordcount.py
echo "=== wordcount.py full ===" && cat wordcount.py
echo "=== .gitignore ===" && cat .gitignore
echo "=== README.md ===" && cat README.md
